rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poorly expanded, low-quality blastocyst with indistinct/absent ICM and sparse irregular TE, consistent with 1DD. Minor uncertainty remains because some comments (possible collapse, central density) go slightly beyond what can be firmly concluded from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, paternal age, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: poor ICM/TE and age drive low prognosis, while favorable lining and prior live birth modestly temper but do not override embryo-related concerns.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including cautious counseling, SET, avoiding unsupported add-ons, and individualized discussion of PGT-A. Slight deduction because some suggestions (e.g., sperm DNA fragmentation testing) are more selective than guideline-core.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer counseling and future planning, including embryo prioritization, protocol review, uterine assessment, male-factor workup, and lifestyle optimization.
